COROS FIT to CSV Converter

Convert COROS .FIT workout files into one complete CSV while keeping the original activity file on your device.

Convert a FIT file🔒 Local processing

Convert exported COROS FIT activities

If you export an activity as a FIT file from a COROS workflow, FIT2CSV can decode the file in your browser and export the FIT messages and fields exposed by the parser into a single CSV.

Useful running data stays available

When present in the source FIT file, decoded fields can include heart rate, cadence, power, altitude, GPS, laps, timestamped records, device information, and running-dynamics fields. FIT2CSV does not intentionally remove activity fields exposed by the parser.

Raw decoded export, not a coaching report

The converter does not infer workout type or add derived coaching metrics. Its job is conversion: decode the binary FIT data and serialize the parser output into CSV so analysis can happen separately.

Your workout stays in the browser

There is no FIT upload API or activity database behind the converter. Processing happens locally with JavaScript in the browser.

Frequently asked questions

Can I convert a COROS FIT file to CSV?

Yes. Select or drop the exported COROS FIT activity into FIT2CSV and download the decoded data as one CSV.

Does FIT2CSV upload my COROS workout?

No. The FIT file is processed locally in the browser.

Will device information be included?

If device information is present in the FIT file and exposed by the parser, it is included in the full decoded CSV.

Are pace or coaching metrics added?

No. FIT2CSV keeps the CSV focused on decoded FIT messages and fields rather than adding derived coaching metrics.
